steps.path: Marketplace → Civic Report, the chips under the name
steps.headline: Every chip under the name is now the same size — the installs chip is no longer tiny.
steps.changed: Three different chip styles shared that row (the installs chip had a tighter line, the thumbs chip larger text). All of them, and the topic chips in About, now use one chip.
steps.notice: Likely safe, YouCoded, @destin, 412 installs and 93% line up at one height on every detail page.

steps.path: Any plugin or skill page → Feedback (here: Brainstorming)
steps.headline: Three tidier Feedback cards. Which should every detail page use?
steps.notice: All three: the votes line has its words on the left and the two buttons on the right; comments sit as plain rows in one box; the box to write in has Post inside it (Enter also posts).
steps.risk: The comment box is one line now; a long comment scrolls sideways while typing.

variants.label: One card
variants.summary: Votes, comments and the box to write in, all in one Feedback card.

variants.label: Two cards
variants.summary: A small Feedback card with just the votes, and a separate Comments card under it.
variants.risk: One more label and card on the page.

variants.label: A question
variants.summary: One card that opens with 'Did it help you?', the percentage under it, then the comments.

steps.headline: Three ways to lay out a theme page. Which do you prefer?
steps.notice: Same pieces in all three — the top card (name, heart, star, share, buttons), the preview picture and the colours. Only where they sit changes.

variants.label: Card first
variants.summary: Round 1's order: the top card across the top, then a big Preview card with the colours under the picture.

variants.label: Picture first
variants.summary: The preview picture leads, full width; the top card and the colours come under it.
variants.risk: On a laptop screen the Apply theme button starts below the fold — you scroll to it.

variants.label: Picture beside
variants.summary: The picture large on the left; the top card and the colours stacked on the right, buttons full width.
variants.risk: The theme's name wraps onto two lines in the narrow right column.

steps.path: Marketplace → Themes → Cotton Candy Sky (not installed)
steps.headline: The same three layouts for a theme you don't have yet. Which do you prefer?
steps.notice: Pick the same as above unless one reads better with a single Install button.

variants.label: Card first
variants.summary: Top card with a full-width Install, then the preview.

variants.label: Picture first
variants.summary: The picture leads; Install sits under it in the top card.
variants.risk: Install starts below the fold on a laptop screen.

variants.label: Picture beside
variants.summary: The picture on the left; Install at the top of the right column.

steps.path: Any theme page → the heart at the top right of the top card
steps.headline: The like heart is a proper heart now, the same size as the star and share icons beside it.
steps.changed: The old heart drawing was broken on its right side. It is redrawn as a normal symmetric heart, and the button is the same kind as the star and share.
steps.notice: A liked theme fills the heart in the theme's accent colour, like a favourited star, instead of red.
steps.risk: The heart is no longer red when liked; say if you want red back.

steps.headline: Plugin pages now use the two-column layout you picked: reading on the left, short facts on the right.
steps.changed: About, What's inside and Feedback are on the left; What this can do and Source on the right. The popup is wider.
steps.notice: On a phone it falls back to one column (next steps).

steps.headline: A bundle in two columns: its list of skills on the left, what it can do and its source on the right.
steps.changed: Same pieces as round 1, rearranged. A long source address now breaks onto a second line instead of running under the Open button.
steps.notice: The 14 skill rows are on the left, so the facts stay visible beside them.

steps.path: Marketplace → Browser Use (flagged by the check)
steps.headline: The flagged-item page in two columns; the amber warning stays inside 'What this can do' on the right.
steps.changed: Layout only. The warning box and the full-width Install are unchanged.
steps.notice: The warning is in the narrower right column, so its lines wrap more.

steps.headline: The connection page in two columns, with the tidier Feedback card on the left.
steps.changed: Layout and the new Feedback card. The 'not installable from here' notice and Open source stay in the top card.
steps.notice: The Source card's pinned-version line is shorter: 'The files we checked are pinned to this version.'

steps.path: Marketplace → Connect your stuff → Google Workspace
steps.headline: Integration pages in two columns: About on the left, Setup on the right.
steps.changed: Layout only. Topic chips use the same one chip size.
steps.notice: Uninstall and Connect stay at the right of the top card.

steps.path: Marketplace on a phone (390 wide) → Civic Report
steps.headline: On a phone the page stays one column, in the same order as before.
steps.changed: The wider popup shrinks to the phone; the columns fold into one: top card, reading, then the facts.
steps.notice: Same as round 1, plus the same-size chips.

steps.path: Marketplace in a small window (640 by 480) → Civic Report
steps.headline: In a small window the two columns fold into one, and the body scrolls under the fade.
steps.changed: The layout switches to one column below phone-tablet width, as on a phone.
steps.notice: At 640 wide it is already one column; the two columns start at wider windows.
